from collections import defaultdict

THRESHOLD = 3

fails_by_user_ip = defaultdict(int)

with open("auth.log", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        parts = dict(item.split("=", 1) for item in line.strip().split() if "=" in item)
        user = parts.get("user", "unknown")
        ip = parts.get("ip", "unknown")
        status = parts.get("status", "unknown")

        if status == "fail":
            fails_by_user_ip[(user, ip)] += 1

for (user, ip), count in sorted(fails_by_user_ip.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
    if count >= THRESHOLD:
